name: metaden
description: MetaDen v1.1 — Self-hosted movie file renamer. Scans a media folder, searches IMDB via OMDb, downloads posters from TMDB, and renames files using a configurable format template. v1.1 adds subtitle support via OpenSubtitles — search and download subtitles with release-match detection. Built with FastAPI + Vue 3.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Where MetaDen stores its configuration and settings.

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Root path to your media. You will browse this folder from within MetaDen to find movies to rename.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the MetaDen web interface.

variables.name: TMDB API Key
variables.description: Your TMDB API key for downloading movie posters. Get a free key at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

variables.name: OMDb API Key
variables.description: Your OMDb API key for IMDB movie data. Get a free key at https://www.omdbapi.com/apikey.aspx

variables.name: OpenSubtitles API Key
variables.description: Optional: Your OpenSubtitles API key for subtitle search and download. Register a free consumer key at https://www.opensubtitles.com/en/consumers

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file permissions. Use the ID of the user who owns your media files.
